notes.title: Progress update #7
notes.content:
The development has been smooth sailing so far, I upgraded my gig to a new monitor and an RTX 3090 GPU so rendering time would be much faster, hopefully it will be enough to make up for the lost time.

The recent news about Steam and Itch banning NSFW games are indeed worrying, but for the time being it hasn't affects Esoterika's development. 

I've decided to start posting progress update here on Steam. Maybe once a month or something like that. I'll also try to be more active, if you have any question i'll be happy to answer, just send it down below. That being said, I'll still be the most active on my discord: https://discord.gg/PUVkPUexAe

 

Here are some sneak peeks at 0.4. [img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45207664/ee63fea9326e4c77fffc6023dac02725888d6a45.png"]
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45207664/ba1bfd8f45f502fdc40fd53cec0d4c14e21f9041.png"]

notes.title: A very important update
notes.content:
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45207664/10b98158a08626dba344e6c71d04176928b05712.png"]
Hey there, this is Inkshade, the developer of Esoterika



It is with a heavy heart that I have to proclaim the following...


Military rations suck. They're decent, mind you, but only meant to provide essential nutrients and sate hunger – no more, no less.
With that out of the way: Active development of Esoterika resumes!
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45207664/632be777e69d6bb8b8e6a5fcdcca041b32fae332.png"]
Actually, not immediately. When this post goes live, I will still be settling back into civilian life. Being away from a computer for half a year certainly didn't do wonders for my rhythm – but rest assured, I will be back into my groove in no time at all!

Which, of course, means that the next update of Esoterika, the 0.4 update, will take a bit longer than it usually would. I don't want to mention any numbers whatsoever – lest they later be used against me in the court of public opinion – but there will absolutely be an update before the end of 2025th year!

To all our fans who supported us (subscribed or not) through this time – thank you, from the bottom of my heart! Just like you, I am eager to get back into the world of Esoterika, and continue telling a gripping story of love, lust, and betrayal!

Until next time...
